name: Hebrew Bridge
description: Translates a stream of messages from a watched chat into your language and delivers it over a separate channel.

groupJid.description: JID of the primary source group

targetLanguage.description: Target language, written in English as a hint for the model: Russian, English, German…

telegramChatId.description: Telegram chat id to send the translations to

debounceMs.description: Silence before a batch is sent, ms (default 20000)

maxWaitMs.description: Maximum wait during a continuous stream, ms (default 120000)

maxBatch.description: Maximum messages in a single batch (default 15)

contextSize.description: How many previous messages to pass as context (default 10)

alertOn.description: Trigger words that flag a message

glossary.description: Glossary: how to spell names and terms in the target language

dryRun.description: Do not deliver, only write to the log

debugHooks.description: Diagnostics: log every incoming hook event

groupJids.description: Additional group JIDs (e.g. a test group)

agentId.description: Agent whose model and credentials to use for translation

blockAgent.description: Keep the agent from handling messages of watched groups (default yes)

audioLanguage.description: Language of voice messages for transcription (default he)

imageProvider.description: Provider for image reading, e.g. openai

imageModel.description: Model for image reading, e.g. gpt-5.4-mini

selfTestImage.description: Path to an image for a one-off text-reading self-check at startup

dataDir.description: Folder for journals and cost accounting (default ~/.openclaw/hebrew-bridge)

logRetentionDays.description: How many days to keep the journals (default 60)

sampleRetentionDays.description: How many days to keep the saved texts in samples/ (default 7)

prices.description: Prices in dollars per million tokens, overriding the built-in ones

quotaWatch.description: Watch the remaining subscription quota (default yes)

quotaThreshold.description: Percentage threshold below which a warning is sent (default 20)

quotaCheckMinutes.description: How often to check the quota, minutes (default 30)

cliPath.description: Path to the openclaw CLI used for the quota check

alertChatId.description: Where to send technical warnings (default: same place as the translations)

quotaRepeatHours.description: Do not repeat a warning about the same window more than once every N hours (default 6)

imageTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for image recognition, ms (default 120000)

logTexts.description: Keep the texts (original, recognised, translated) for quality review

routes.description: Chats and where to deliver their translations. Each has its own context and glossary.

targetLanguage.description: Target language, written in English as a hint for the model: Russian, English, German…

glossary.description: Names and terms specific to this chat

source.description: Where to read from: source identifier (default whatsapp)

delivery.description: Where to deliver: delivery identifier (default telegram)

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the source messages, in English: Hebrew, Arabic… (optional)

ownerName.description: Whose mentions to mark with the ⚑ flag

labels.description: Attachment captions in your language: image, audio, video, document, sticker

labelsPlural.description: How to name attachments in the plural: image: {icon, word}

timeZone.description: Time zone for the headers, e.g. Asia/Jerusalem (default: the server zone)

locale.description: Time format, e.g. ru-RU or en-GB (default: 24-hour)

model.description: A dedicated model for this route, as provider/model (e.g. openrouter/google/gemini-3.7-flash). Without it the agent model is used.

muteWhatsAppOutbound.description: Mute ALL outbound WhatsApp traffic, direct chats included (default yes)

replay.description: One-off replay: take the chat messages from the log and translate them

jid.description: The chat whose messages to replay

minutes.description: How many minutes back to look (default 120)

sender.description: What to label the sender as

authProbe.description: One-off check: whether the plugin can reach providers directly

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the source messages, in English: Hebrew, Arabic… (optional)

ownerName.description: Whose mentions to mark with the ⚑ flag

labels.description: Attachment captions in your language: image, audio, video, document, sticker

labelsPlural.description: How to name attachments in the plural: image: {icon, word}

timeZone.description: Time zone for the headers, e.g. Asia/Jerusalem (default: the server zone)

locale.description: Time format, e.g. ru-RU or en-GB (default: 24-hour)

groupRegistry.description: Keep a registry of seen conversations (default yes)

groupScanMinutes.description: How often to scan the log for conversations, minutes (default 60)

debounceMs.label: Debounce, ms
debounceMs.help: Silence before a batch is sent
